findings.title: Fallback translation files are only loaded for controller requests
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is invoked only from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` still only loads the current locale before translating and never loads fallback locales itself. In non-controller contexts such as Sidekiq jobs, mailers, or rake tasks, `I18n.translate` can be called with a non-English locale and a key missing from that locale. The site-default and English fallback locale files will not have been loaded, so fallback lookups can return a missing translation even when the key exists in the fallback files. Fallback loading should be triggered from the I18n translate path or wherever I18n.locale is set outside controllers.

findings.title: Runtime default locale changes can serve stale fallback translations
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` makes fallback results depend on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, which can be changed at runtime by an admin. However `I18n.translate` in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` caches translations with a key composed only of the translation key, current locale, and backend object id (line 72). If `SiteSetting.default_locale` changes, cached missing-key translations for a locale will still reflect the old default locale, because the cache is not invalidated by the setting change and the cache key does not include fallback configuration. The cache key should include fallback-relevant information or the cache should be invalidated when the default locale changes.

findings.title: English locale can fall back to a non-English site default
findings.body: The fallback list is always `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`. When `I18n.locale` is `:en` and the site default is not English, this reduces to `[:en, :fr]` (for example). A missing English translation will then be looked up in the site-default language instead of remaining English. For English requests the site-default fallback should not be inserted after `:en`; the chain should stop at `[:en]` or otherwise prefer English last.

findings.title: No tests added for fallback behavior
findings.body: This PR introduces a custom fallback order, eager fallback loading, and removal of environment fallback configuration, but adds no specs. The behavior around missing keys, English vs site default locale, runtime default locale changes, and non-controller translation paths is subtle and can regress silently. Tests should cover `FallbackLocaleList` ordering and ensure fallback locales are loaded in all contexts that call `I18n.translate`.
